status: pre-inference design; runtime and source corpus must be sealed before campaign
search_selection: lexicographic full successes, first validation successes, lower measured episode total tokens; keep parent on exact tie
control_alignment: same public retrieval positive program IDs, tasks, initial code, seed, model, actions, wall limit; evolved arms use same proposals and cap
final_policy: after freezing selected C/I, source corpus, tasks/verifiers and runtime/model protocol, final outcomes cannot change strategies or selection
evidence: only complete authenticated source branches are positive; preserve rejected and falsified evidence
statistics: semantic task is unit; seeds and recovery cases clustered within task; exploratory small pilot
selection: generate only on development feedback; select among C0 and all actual candidates on a separate 2-task selection set, same objective and no further proposals
agent_prompt_version: forkrsi-next-action-v1; calibrated only on source-side read loops; frozen for all controls
extraction_seed_policy: same seed per shared positive source, independent of C lineage/evidence mode; reuse identical prompt+seed extraction
no_op_policy: retain/evaluate no-op C candidates and costs; they consume proposal slots but cannot be selected as changed compilers
json_protocol: forkrsi-json-schema-feedback-v1; unchanged strict parsing, four-attempt cap, bounded validation diagnostics
response_failure_policy: verify-current-code-v1: four failed JSON attempts terminate the task by verifying existing code, without extra requests or edits; exhausted source proposal slots retained without evidence
